ratings.comment: EXCELLENT PROFESSOR.  Has by far the most interesting engineering project of all the 160 labs, and is one of those guys that cares far more about teaching and making sure you learn something rather than letter grades and reports.  TAKE HIS LAB!!!!!
Great class! Anderson is amazing! I recommend any of his classes!
Provided by far the most interesting topic for the 160 class out of all the other projects. Would highly recommend this professor to anyone looking to take InterEgr 160.

Such a great professor. Highly recommend him for 160.  He really gives you some challenging projects and goals, but manages to make it really stimulating and easy to enjoy.  Overall, he's one of those prof what really can make learning fun!
Far and above the best chemistry class that I have ever taken. The class is informative, mentally stimulating, and fun.   Not to mention Professor Anderson is HOT!
He is very involved in this class.  I'd recommend Interegr 160 to all pre-engineering students.
Great teacher! very helpful, very enthusiastic about our projects. a great help with them too. class is never dull when he is around.
Great class with him.  Very into his research and what he was doing.  Bought the whole class subs at times.  Encouraging and a good guy.
if he were 20 yrs younger or I were 5 years older, i would date him
Great teacher, very enthusiastic and great for encouraging engineering students to continue their education.

Great class!  there are two instructors for this class and Anderson is the highlight.  I was never bored when he lectured - the dude is seriously excited about water!  Group projects were a blast.  Exams are VERY LONG, but we got unlimited time to finish.  The class would be better with a lab, but otherwise excellent.
